title: MessageSentPayload

runId.description: A run's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when the run starts or is adopted.

messageId.description: A user message's id: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when a client sends it, and the id the provider is handed.

skill.description: The member a leading slash resolved to; text remains what the person typed.

name.description: A skill's name, by the Agent Skills rule: 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9 and -, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. Refused as invalid_params, the issue's params naming the rule skill-name and its reason.

repository.description: The identity of the repository the member was read from: its source's, or the trusted repository's.

path.description: The member's folder in that repository, from its root; . when the root is itself the skill.

oneOf.description: The repository the member was read from, by its identity, and the member's folder there.

repository.description: The identity of the repository the manifest says the member was copied from.

path.description: The member's folder in that repository, as the manifest names it.

anyOf.description: The commit the member was copied at, as the manifest names it: its object name, full or abbreviated.

licence.description: The licence the manifest names, an SPDX identifier where it gives one; null when it names none.

oneOf.description: What a provenance manifest beside the member names: the repository and folder it was copied from, the commit and the licence.

anyOf.description: Where a member comes from, which the readiness overlay is keyed by (repository identity and folder path): the repository it was read from, or what a provenance manifest beside a copy names.

kind.description: What an attachment is: an image (the adapter needs imageInput) or a file (fileInput).

items.description: An attachment as the log records it: kind, name, media type and size; the bytes are never logged.

delivery.description: prompt: the message starts the run; queued: a run was live, so it waits to be steered or read (message.delivered).

anyOf.description: Who holds a queued message: the provider's queue (it may steer it into the running turn), or the environment's (the next run starts with it).

heldBy.description: Who holds a queued message; null for a prompt.

ceiling.description: The ceiling of the client session that sent it (ADR 0006): a run the environment later starts with it is clamped to it, as well as to the ceiling of whoever started that run.

description: message.sent: a client sent the session a message; runId is the run it starts, or the run live when it was queued.
